limitations: The theorem concerns the 14-vertex Heawood graph alone. It does not generalize to arbitrary projective planes. The classical Coxeter–Heawood hexagon correspondence is prior art. Scientific priority remains provisional.
scientific_integrity: Exact fixed-graph result. Three supplied standalone verifiers produced matching finite certificates; a structural lower-bound and optimum-classification proof is included. No external independent audit or exhaustive priority proof is claimed.
title: The Coxeter line graph of optimal edge dominators in the Heawood graph
